summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh GitHub releases, chmods it 0755, and uses it to execute a co-shipped 727KB obfuscated bundle `math_init.js`. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with identifier renaming (`_0xNNNNNN`) and indirect string-dictionary lookups. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle using a rotated string-array decoder (function `WV8StW` shifting the `n7gIxM` array combined with a char-permutation string) to reconstruct identifiers and literals only at runtime, so the payload's network destinations and behavior cannot be observed without executing the decoder under Bun. Alternate-runtime execution routes the payload around Node-based scanning. The package is presented as a CircleCI-orb YAML aggregator: `package.json` declares `main: index.js` but no `index.js` exists in the tarball, the `repository` field points at `ornikar/orb-frontend-native` while the package is published under a word-reordered name `native-frontend-orb`, and a benign CircleCI-orb YAML tree in `src/` acts as cover. Installing this package causes attacker-controlled obfuscated code to run on the installer host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
